facts.why: Caste, income, domicile and marriage certificates, and most SDM work, now go to Central North, not North.

facts.value: MCD 311 app or the MCD portal for garbage, street light, road, park, dead animal, burning waste and mosquito-breeding complaints. Note the complaint number; it is what an RTI or a follow-up hangs on.

facts.label: Tenders and contracts
facts.value: What works today: on both the Delhi e-tendering portal and the central CPP portal, the 'Tenders by Organisation' pages open a department's full live tender list (PWD, DJB, DDA and so on) without a captcha, and each tender's own page gives the work, the tender value, the period of work and the reference number. What does not work: 'Results of Tenders', which is where the winning contractor and the awarded amount sit, is captcha-gated, so contractor names cannot be read from here. MCD publishes on neither portal and its own tender pages did not load today. Search by organisation, then look for 'Model Town', 'Civil Lines' or 'North Zone'.
facts.why: The contractor name, contract value and defect-liability period are the only way to hold anyone to a badly built road.

facts.label: Orders, gazette and air quality
facts.value: Delhi Gazette notifications, CAQM orders for GRAP stages, and Delhi Police / traffic advisories. GRAP = Graded Response Action Plan, the staged pollution restrictions for Delhi-NCR.
facts.why: Prohibitory orders (Section 163 BNSS), construction bans and vehicle curbs all start as one of these notices.

facts.label: Right to Information
facts.value: For a civic work in this ward, file with the PIO of the Executive Engineer concerned, MCD Civil Lines Zone; for water and sewer, the PIO of the relevant DJB division; for electricity, TPDDL is covered as a public authority for certain matters. RTI Online covers central bodies; Delhi bodies are filed with their own PIOs.
facts.why: An RTI with the correct PIO and a complaint number attached is the fastest way to get a tender or work file.

items.title: Names on file: the officers who now handle this PIN
items.what_happened: The Central North district website's Who's Who, updated 24 September 2026, names Shailendra Singh Parihar as District Magistrate, Rajiv Ranjan as ADM, Kuldeep Singh Dhama as SDM (Model Town) on 011-20872674, and Devender Kumar as Tehsildar (Model Town). The Revenue Department's own list, updated 23 September 2026, names Sandeep Sindhu as Sub-Registrar (Model Town). On the police side, the Delhi Police directory dated 27 January 2026 names Bhisham Singh, IPS as DCP North West on 011-27229835, with Additional DCP-I Sikandar Singh as PIO.
items.why_matters: Certificates, land records and police escalations all need a named officer and a number; guessing the office sends your letter nowhere.
items.action: Address written complaints to the named officer at the DC Office Complex, Lawrence Road, Rampura, Delhi 110035. Keep a copy: it is what an RTI attaches to.
items.source: District Central North Who's Who and Delhi Revenue Department list of Sub-Registrars, both official, September 2026

items.title: Winter pollution rules now switch on automatically from 1 November
items.what_happened: Delhi has notified a standing winter air quality framework that applies every year from 1 November to 28 February without a fresh order. Reported provisions: non-Delhi registered vehicles that are not BS-VI barred from 1 November to 31 January (electric, CNG and emergency vehicles exempt), outdoor civil construction stopped over the same window except essential public infrastructure, offices asked to keep only half their staff physically present with staggered timings, anti-smog guns required at large sites, and no fuel without a valid PUC certificate at any time.
items.why_matters: If a family car is registered outside Delhi, or a flat or RWA project is mid-construction, the cut-off is 1 November and there will be no separate warning this year.
items.action: Renew PUC now. If you plan civil work at home, finish or pause it before 1 November. Track live stages on the CAQM GRAP orders page.
items.source: Outlook India (3 July 2026) and Open magazine on the notified winter framework; consolidates GRAP, CAQM and Supreme Court directions

items.title: Your revenue district changed: Model Town is now Central North
items.what_happened: Delhi's revenue districts went from 11 to 13 with effect from 1 January 2026, approved by the Cabinet on 11 December 2025 and notified after the Lieutenant Governor's assent. Old Delhi, Central North and Outer North were created. Model Town sub-division, with Shakur Basti and Shalimar Bagh, now sits in Central North. Sub-divisions and sub-registrar offices go from 22 to 39, with district mini secretariats planned. Delhi Police districts are unchanged, so this PIN is still policed by North West district.
items.why_matters: Certificates, land records and SDM grievances for 110009 now belong to a different district than before. Old forms and old office addresses will send you to the wrong counter.
items.action: Use the e-District sub-division contact list to confirm your office before going. SDM (Model Town) is listed at Old Middle School Building, Lawrence Road, Rampura, Delhi 110035.
items.source: e-District Delhi sub-division contact list (official) and The Federal, 28 December 2025

items.title: Who signs off your civic work: MCD Commissioner Sanjeev Khirwar
items.what_happened: Sanjeev Khirwar, IAS, took charge as Municipal Commissioner of MCD on 21 January 2026. Pravesh Wahi took over as Mayor on 29 April 2026 after Raja Iqbal Singh's one-year term.
items.why_matters: Large ward works, waste contracts and departmental action for Civil Lines Zone are cleared at Commissioner level, so escalation above the zone goes to this office.
items.action: Escalate a stuck 311 complaint in writing to the Deputy Commissioner, Civil Lines Zone first, then to the Commissioner's office, quoting the complaint number.
items.source: Daily Pioneer and Elets eGov, January 2026; WION, April 2026

items.title: Bhalswa landfill: December 2026 clearance target, about 40 lakh tonnes left
items.what_happened: MCD's stated target is to fully flatten the Bhalswa dump by December 2026. Of 1.09 crore tonnes, 68.8 lakh tonnes had been biomined as of 7 November 2025, leaving roughly 40.5 lakh tonnes, while fresh waste and silt kept arriving. Ten extra acres were added at the site for wet waste processing.
items.why_matters: Bhalswa is a few kilometres upwind of Model Town. Landfill fires there are a direct air quality event for this PIN, and the December deadline is the yardstick to hold MCD to.
items.action: Report smoke or fire at the site on MCD 311 and to the Delhi Pollution Control Committee. Ask MCD Civil Lines Zone for the monthly biomining figure by RTI if the target slips.
items.source: MCD figures reported in Delhi press, November 2025; MCD December 2026 target

items.title: UPDATE: six days left to get your name back on the voter roll
items.what_happened: Delhi's draft roll after the Special Intensive Revision was published on 31 August 2026 and left out about 47.7 lakh of 1.45 crore names. Claims and objections close on 30 September 2026; notices are to be disposed of by 29 October and the final roll is published on 4 November 2026. On 23 September the Delhi Chief Electoral Officer said no name will be deleted without due process and a hearing.
items.why_matters: If your name is missing and you do nothing by 30 September, you stay off the roll until the next revision.
items.action: Check your name at voters.eci.gov.in or on the ECINET app. If missing, file Form 6 with documents online, or with the BLO/ERO for Model Town constituency. ECI helpline 1950.
items.source: Chief Electoral Officer Delhi (SIR FAQ) and ANI, 23 September 2026

items.title: Rs 4.35 crore road safety audit tendered for the whole PWD North Zone
items.what_happened: PWD published tender 2026_PWD_298789_1 on 22 September 2026 for consultancy services for a traffic simulation model and a road safety audit of PWD North Zone, which includes the roads around this PIN. Tender value Rs 4,35,00,000, period of work 730 days, location recorded as North Delhi. Reference 26/EE/NR/PWD/26-27/Delhi. Bids close 13 October 2026; the pre-bid meeting is at the Office of the Chief Engineer, North Zone, 5th floor, MSO Building.
items.why_matters: A road safety audit is the document that later decides where signals, footpaths and crossings go on North Delhi roads, for the next two years.
items.action: Search tender ID 2026_PWD_298789_1 on the Delhi e-tendering portal. Residents' associations can send junction and blackspot complaints to the Chief Engineer, PWD North Zone, before the consultant starts.
items.source: Delhi government e-tendering portal (Public Works Department listing), tender published 22 September 2026

items.title: Supreme Court issues notice to Election Commission on Delhi SIR
items.what_happened: On 22 September 2026 the Supreme Court issued notice to the Election Commission on a plea challenging the Delhi Special Intensive Revision process, and suggested that Booth Level Officers give more help to affected voters.
items.why_matters: The deadline has not moved. Until a court says otherwise, 30 September still applies to you.
items.action: Do not wait for the case. File Form 6 now and keep the acknowledgement.
items.source: Social News XYZ / IANS report of Supreme Court proceedings, 22 September 2026

items.title: Rs 85.2 lakh PWD tender covers festive lighting from Model Town-I metro station
items.what_happened: PWD's North Electrical Division floated tender 2026_PWD_298491_1 on 16 September 2026: maintenance and electricity consumption charges for street lighting on PWD roads under the division, with a sub-head for temporary beautification lighting on Independence Day, Republic Day and Diwali starting from Model Town-I metro station. Tender value Rs 85,20,000. Reference 22/EE(E)/NED/PWD/M-352/2026-27. Period of work 365 days. Bids close and open on 26 September 2026 at the NED office, Dr BSA Hospital. The portal records the division's own PIN (110085) and gives the work location as 'as per NIT', so the exact stretch is in the tender document, not the listing. The winning contractor is not published yet.
items.why_matters: This is the money behind the street lights on your own stretch of Ring Road, and the festival lighting starts at the Model Town metro station.
items.action: Search tender ID 2026_PWD_298491_1 on the Delhi e-tendering portal to read the NIT and the road list. For a dark street, complain to PWD North Electrical Division and quote this tender.
items.source: Delhi government e-tendering portal (Public Works Department listing), tender published 16 September 2026

items.title: Snatching arrests: one accused is a Mukherjee Nagar resident
items.what_happened: On 16 September 2026 Delhi Police's anti-snatching cell arrested two men caught snatching a phone from a taxi driver near Ring Road; one accused, aged 27, is a resident of Mukherjee Nagar, which falls in PIN 110009. Separately, in August a snatching case under North West district was solved within an hour by Police Post Sangam Park.
items.why_matters: Two-wheeler phone snatching on Ring Road and around the Mukherjee Nagar coaching belt is the most common street crime pattern for this PIN.
items.action: Report a snatching immediately on 112 and get the e-FIR number the same day; insurance and SIM blocking both need it. PS Model Town or PS Mukherjee Nagar depending on your street.
items.source: Delhi Police statements reported by Punjab Kesari and other outlets, 16 September 2026

items.title: Dengue peak: 121 cases in September, 432 in Delhi this year
items.what_happened: MCD's weekly vector-borne disease report up to 12 September 2026 records 121 dengue cases in September alone, more than a quarter of the year's 432, and 71 in the preceding week. MCD says it has inspected over 2.79 crore houses this year, found larvae in 1.47 lakh of them and issued more than 1.10 lakh legal notices.
items.why_matters: September and October are peak breeding months here. Coolers, overhead tanks, sumps and terrace junk in Model Town's older plots are the usual sources, and a legal notice to a household is a real possibility.
items.action: Empty and dry coolers once a week. Report standing water or a missed fogging round on the MCD 311 app and keep the complaint number.
items.source: MCD weekly vector-borne report, reported by Millennium Post and The Patriot, September 2026

items.title: Your MCD zone is set to be renamed from Civil Lines to North
items.what_happened: The MCD Standing Committee, chaired by Satya Sharma, cleared a proposal in April 2026 to rename the civic zones so they match Delhi's revenue districts. Under it Civil Lines Zone becomes North, Narela becomes Outer North, Rohini becomes North West and Keshavpuram becomes North Central; South and West keep their names. Whether the renaming has been notified and implemented could not be confirmed today.
items.why_matters: Ward 68 sits in Civil Lines Zone. If the label changes, complaint forms, zone offices and old addresses stop matching what staff use.
items.action: When filing anything with MCD, quote Ward 68 Model Town as well as the zone name, so a rename cannot misroute it.
items.source: Daily Pioneer and The Tribune reports on the Standing Committee decision, April 2026

items.title: ARCHIVED: TPDDL power shutdown 22-23 September
items.what_happened: Model Town Circle shutdown 10:30 to 12:30 on 22 and 23 September 2026. The window has passed; kept on file as a record, not as a live alert.
items.why_matters: Daytime cuts affect lifts, pumps and work from home.

items.title: ARCHIVED: property tax rebate window for 2026-27 has closed
items.what_happened: MCD's 10 per cent rebate for paying the full 2026-27 property tax was extended from 30 June to 31 July 2026, and MCD said there would be no further extension. The SUNIYO amnesty scheme for old dues ran until 30 April 2026.
items.why_matters: Kept on file so next year's rebate date is not missed; the window reopens at the start of the financial year.
items.action: Pay and download the receipt on the MCD portal. Watch for the 2027-28 rebate notice in April.
items.source: Delhi press reports on MCD rebate and amnesty deadlines, 2026

items.title: ARCHIVED: May 2026 water crisis hit Model Town directly
items.what_happened: In late May 2026 the Wazirabad and Chandrawal treatment plants ran far below capacity as the Yamuna ran low. Model Town and Mukherjee Nagar were named among the worst affected areas. DJB diverted raw water from the Munak canal through Haiderpur to bring the plants back to about 70 to 80 per cent.
items.why_matters: This PIN sits at the end of the Wazirabad and Chandrawal supply, so any raw-water shortfall shows up here first. Background for the next summer.
items.action: Keep the DJB complaint number 1916 and book tankers through the DJB portal, not through private numbers.
items.source: India TV report on the May 2026 supply shortfall, 28 May 2026

history.title: How this area came to be
history.note: Where Model Town, Tagore Park and the colonies around them came from, and what the PIN actually contains.

facts.label: A privately planned colony, built in the early 1950s
facts.value: Model Town was laid out by the DLF group, then Delhi Land and Finance, founded by Chaudhary Raghvendra Singh in 1946. It is one of the first privately developed neighbourhoods in Delhi, built on land the area's earlier landowners put into the scheme, and it filled up through the 1960s and 1970s with professionals, officials and traders. It is laid out in three parts, Model Town I, II and III.
facts.why: It explains the shape of the place: wide plotted blocks, its own main roads and markets, and older leasehold paperwork on many plots.

sources.label: DLF (company): origins as Delhi Land and Finance

facts.label: What is actually inside ward 68
facts.value: The State Election Commission's own ward 68 map labels: Model Town Blocks A to H and K, Gujranwala Town Blocks A and B and Parts II and III, Derawal Nagar Blocks A and B, Kalyan Vihar, Kingsway Camp, Police Lines and the Police Residential Colony, DTC Colony, Municipal Colony, State Bank Colony, Mahendra Enclave, New Gupta Colony, Ishwar Colony, Priyadarshani Vihar, CC Colony, Kirpal Bagh, Rajpur Chhawni and Malikpur Chhawni, with GTB Nagar and Azadpur on its edges. Landmarks on the map: Chhatrasal Stadium, PS Model Town, Model Town metro station, Hans and Alpana cinemas.
facts.why: This is the definitive list of which streets your councillor answers for.

facts.label: Census 2011: the old North Delhi district (which then contained Model Town)
facts.value: Population 8,87,978 (4,75,002 male, 4,12,976 female), up 13.62% from 7,81,525 in 2001. Area 61 sq km, density 14,557 per sq km, which was 5.29% of Delhi's population. Sex ratio 869 women per 1,000 men; child sex ratio (0-6) 873. Literacy 86.85% overall, 90.89% male, 82.20% female. Children aged 0-6: 1,03,304, or 11.63% of the district. 5,071 families were recorded as living without a roof.
facts.why: This is the only hard demographic baseline that exists for the area; treat it as 2011, not as today.

civic.title: Services, environment and what is coming
civic.note: How the utilities, the air and the big plans touch this PIN.

facts.label: Water: you sit at the end of the Wazirabad and Chandrawal line
facts.value: Delhi Jal Board supplies this PIN from the Wazirabad and Chandrawal treatment plants. In late May 2026, when the Yamuna ran low and both plants fell far below capacity, Model Town and Mukherjee Nagar were named among the worst hit; DJB diverted Munak canal water through Haiderpur to bring them back to about 70 to 80 per cent. Complaint number 1916.
facts.why: When raw water is short anywhere upstream, this PIN feels it early. Worth knowing before every summer.

facts.label: Electricity: Tata Power-DDL
facts.value: TPDDL distributes power in north and north-west Delhi including 110009. Helpline 19124, SMS 56070, WhatsApp 7303482071 as published in outage notices; re-confirm on the TPDDL site. Planned shutdowns for the Model Town circle are published by TPDDL, not by MCD or the Delhi government.
facts.why: Outage and billing complaints go to the discom; the regulator above it is DERC.

facts.label: Air quality: the stations that speak for this area
facts.value: There is no monitoring station inside 110009. The nearest continuous stations in the CPCB and DPCC network are Ashok Vihar (at Satyawati College, near the Ashok Vihar flyover on GT Karnal Road), Jahangirpuri and Alipur. Readings quoted for 'north Delhi' usually come from these.
facts.why: When a number is quoted for your air, it was measured a few kilometres away, and Bhalswa landfill sits near two of those stations.

sources.label: CPCB: list of continuous air quality monitoring stations (PDF)

facts.label: Land use and the master plan
facts.value: In DDA's zonal plan structure this area falls in Zone C, the Civil Lines zone. The current statutory framework for new development is the Master Plan for Delhi 2041 process run by DDA. What MPD 2041 specifically proposes for Model Town was NOT VERIFIED today.
facts.why: Zoning decides what can be built next door, and the zonal plan is the document to quote in an objection.

facts.value: NOT VERIFIED whether plots here are freehold or on leasehold from DDA or the Land and Development Office. Model Town was privately developed, so the position can differ plot by plot.

facts.label: Big projects to watch around this PIN
facts.value: Two with real local effect: the Bhalswa landfill, which MCD has targeted to flatten by December 2026 and which sits a few kilometres upwind, and the PWD North Zone road safety audit and traffic simulation study tendered in September 2026 at Rs 4.35 crore, which will shape junctions and footpaths here for two years. facts.why: These two decide your air and your roads more than anything announced at city level.
